## Activity

During January 2019, River Outreach recorded 53 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and supports review of the site’s operational workload. The capture volume should be considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes when identifying any follow-up requirements.

## Image quality

There were 7 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 13.2 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered in the review of local operating arrangements. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues consistently will help maintain an appropriate audit trail and support identification of any repeated equipment or process concerns.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 8 days. This measure provides an indication of the time between image capture and completion of grading during the month. The referable results and the ungradable captures should be reviewed through the usual follow-up and quality processes, with attention given to maintaining timely grading and documenting any relevant operational issues.
